title: Simple Hats Collection

body:
# Simple Hats Collection

**An addon for [Simple Hats](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-hats) that turns your hats into a collection to complete and helps you de-clutter you inventory !**

You collected too many Simple Hats and you don't want to recycle them ? Simple Hats Collection gives every player a personal, unlimited **hat collection**: store every hat you find, see at a glance which ones you're still missing, and pull any hat back out whenever you want to wear it.

## Features

*   **🎩 Store any hat in one click :** Shift + right-click a hat in your inventory to send it to your collection.
*   **🎁 Open bags right into your collection :** Shift + right-click a hat bag and the rolled hat goes straight in (normal right-click still opens bags normally).
*   **📖 A collection screen :**  press **K** to browse: collected hats show icon and count. You can also see the ones you are missing.
*   **↩️ Take hats back anytime :** click to withdraw; a pick-list lets you choose which variant/dye to take.
*   **⭐ Favorites**, **🔎 search & sort** (default / A–Z / rarity / quantity), hide missing.
